camel_example: aliyun antiddos-public DescribeInstance --region cn-hangzhou --DdosRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType ecs --version 2017-05-18 --method POST --force
description_en: Retrieves the details of the assets within the current Alibaba Cloud account. The assets can be elastic IP addresses (EIPs). The assets can also be Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances or Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances that are assigned public IP addresses. This operation is phased out. We recommend that you use the DescribeInstanceIpAddress operation
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号拥有的公网IP资产（云服务器ECS实例、负载均衡SLB实例、弹性公网IP实例等）的实例详情，该接口已经过时，推荐使用新接口DescribeInstanceIpAddress
kebab_example: aliyun antiddos-public describe-instance --ddos-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstance

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the asset to query. Valid values:

ecs: ECS instances.

slb: SLB instances.

eip: EIPs.

ipv6: IPv6 gateways.

swas: simple application servers.

waf: Web Application Firewall (WAF) instances of the Exclusive edition.

ga_basic: Global Accelerator (GA) instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：

ecs：表示查询云服务器ECS实例。
slb：表示查询负载均衡SLB实例。
eip：表示查询弹性公网IP实例。
ipv6：表示查询IPv6网关公网实例。
swas：表示查询轻量服务器公网实例。
waf：表示查询Web应用防火墙独享实例。
ga_basic：表示查询全球加速公网实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的实例名称
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The DDoS mitigation status of the asset. Valid values:

mitigating: queries assets for which traffic scrubbing is triggered.

blackholed: queries assets for which blackhole filtering is triggered.

normal: queries assets that are not under DDoS attacks
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的DDoS防护状态。取值：

mitigating：表示清洗中，即查询正在进行流量清洗的公网IP资产。
blackholed：表示黑洞中，即查询处于黑洞状态的公网IP资产。
normal：表示正常，即查询未遭受DDoS攻击的公网IP资产
parameters.name: ddos_status

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset. The formats of asset IDs vary based on the value of the InstanceType. parameter.

If you set InstanceType to ecs, specify the ID of the ECS instance. For example, you can specify i-bp1cb6x80tfgocid\\.

If you set InstanceType to slb, specify the ID of the SLB instance. For example, you can specify alb-vn2dqg3v31y2vd\\.

If you set InstanceType to eip, specify the ID of the EIP. For example, you can specify eip-j6ce6dcx9epi7rs46\\
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的实例ID。根据实例类型（InstanceType）不同，此处设置的实例ID格式不同，具体说明如下：

InstanceType为ecs，在此处设置ECS实例ID，例如，i-bp1cb6x80tfgocid\\。
InstanceType为slb，在此处设置SLB实例ID，例如，alb-vn2dqg3v31y2vd\\。
InstanceType为eip，在此处设置SLB实例ID，例如，eip-j6ce6dcx9epi7rs46\\
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the asset
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的IP地址
parameters.name: instance_ip

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含公网IP资产的数量。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The DDoS mitigation status of the asset. Valid values:

mitigating: indicates that traffic scrubbing is triggered for the asset.

blackholed: indicates that blackhole filtering is triggered for the asset.

normal: indicates that the instance is normal

mitigating：表示清洗中。
blackholed：表示黑洞中。
normal：表示正常

The IP protocol that is supported by the asset. Valid values:

v4: IPv4

v6: IPv6

Indicates whether the asset is associated with an Anti-DDoS Origin Basic instance. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no

实例是否已绑定DDoS原生防护。取值：

true：表示是。
